previously_recorded_relationships.rationale: Stratification verse and vivid reading episode uniquely identify1257, independently of the general last-letter acknowledgment.
Specific question about effect of species work and distinct Himalayan Rubi/willows versus NorthAmerica make this much stronger than the first-pass limited Falconer candidate.
Darwin challenged floating-ice dam theory and complained of reversal in preference for his species/barnacle work; Hooker answers both distinct points before receiving1300 next day.
Express February-letter identification with incomplete water cure and seventh child makes this supported, not a broad candidate from two-month-old letters.
Explicit reference to double chains and later elevation of the one crossed by watercourses answers the distinctive hypothesis in1339P2; further diagram clarifies the disagreement.
